data.name: Paebbl
data.description: Paebbl is a Dutch-Nordic climate-tech startup that permanently stores CO2 by mineralizing it with olivine rock, producing a powder used as a supplementary cementitious material for concrete. Its continuous demo plant in Rotterdam has been running since late March 2025, and the company is designing a first-of-a-kind commercial facility targeted for 2027.
